question_text: What's my revenue this year?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM v_orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2011

question_text: How many orders did I get last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM v_orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2011-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2011-10-01'

question_text: What were sales like last month?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM v_orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2011-11-01' AND order_date < DATE '2011-12-01'

question_text: Top 5 non-UK markets by revenue this year
gold_sql: SELECT country, SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM v_orders WHERE country != 'United Kingdom' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2011 GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC, country ASC LIMIT 5

question_text: Which non-UK market grew fastest from Q2 to Q3 2011?
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT country, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2011-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2011-07-01' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS q2, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2011-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2011-10-01' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS q3 FROM v_orders WHERE country != 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY country) SELECT country, (q3 - q2) / q2 AS growth_rate FROM q WHERE q2 > 0 ORDER BY growth_rate DESC, country ASC LIMIT 1

question_text: Which non-UK country has the highest average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT country, SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM v_orders WHERE country != 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY country ORDER BY aov DESC, country ASC LIMIT 1

question_text: Which products sell best outside the UK, by revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT l.product_id, SUM(l.line_revenue) AS non_uk_revenue FROM v_order_lines l JOIN v_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.country != 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY l.product_id ORDER BY non_uk_revenue DESC, l.product_id ASC LIMIT 5

question_text: What are the top 5 products by revenue, and which region do they sell best in?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, description, total_revenue, top_region FROM v_products ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 5

question_text: How many orders came from EIRE?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM v_orders WHERE country = 'EIRE'

question_text: How many customers do we have outside the UK?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM v_customers WHERE country != 'United Kingdom'

question_text: What percentage of total revenue comes from outside the UK?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN country != 'United Kingdom' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_revenue) AS non_uk_revenue_share FROM v_orders

question_text: Which quarter of 2011 had the highest revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) AS quarter, SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM v_orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2011 GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY revenue DESC, quarter ASC LIMIT 1

question_text: How many orders came from Antarctica?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM v_orders WHERE country = 'Antarctica'
